name: Mark
means: The boss carries an element, with a count from x1 to x3.

name: Reaction
means: A Payoff of the right element cashes a mark: its hit gets a bonus and the count drops by 1.
not: Any hit that meets a mark

name: Spend
means: Pay a cost to do something: part of a mark's count, a Store, or HP. The effect says what and how much.

name: Store
means: Up to 3 points of a named resource on the creature, gained and spent as the effect says.

name: Seal
means: This mark is not shed by the boss.

name: Taunt
means: Every plain attack of the boss aims at this creature (moves do not).

name: Intercept
means: Takes a hit meant for a creature in its reach, after that creature's failed dodge.

name: Retaliate
means: Hits back when it dodges; the hit back ignores armour.

name: Blocked
means: A hit that does not get past armour deals nothing.

name: Silenced
means: Its Knack, talents, gear effects and its role's verb do nothing (a Setter does not mark, a Payoff does not cash, a Guard does not intercept or cover, a Support does not boost or heal). It still hits with its stats.

name: Wind-up
means: A boss move announced at round start: its slots are shown, and it lands on them.

name: Mired
means: A debuff on the boss: per count it deals less damage and dodges less (at most x5). It fades by 1 at the end of every second round.

name: Beside
means: The living creatures in the slots on each side of it, in its row. Never widened.

name: Row end
means: The first or last slot of its row.
not: The end living creature of the row

name: Front row
means: The row nearest the boss.
not: The first row with a creature in it

name: Reach
means: How many slots to each side, in its row, a Guard or Support covers. Starts at Beside; some effects widen it.

name: Boost
means: A Support's bonus on a creature's next hit.

name: Area hit
means: A hit on more than one slot; it is dodged at half chance.
not: A hit a Guard takes for you

name: Scatter
means: A boss move that hits a number of different creatures, drawn at random from the whole arena.
not: A hit on every creature of a row

name: Leap
means: A boss move that hits one creature, then jumps to the strongest creature right next to it, and on, each jump softer.

name: Cross
means: A boss move that hits one creature and the creatures right beside, in front of and behind it.

name: Checker
means: A boss move that hits every other slot of the arena, like the dark squares of a board.

name: Most hurt
means: The creature with the lowest share of its max HP.
not: The creature with the least HP

name: Back-most
means: The living creature in the row furthest from the boss (the leftmost, if several).
not: The creature in the last slot

name: Build-up
means: A boss that grows as a weekend goes on. It fills from something its text names (rounds, HP lost, reactions), grows a step each time it fills, up to a cap, carries across the weekend, and Mired slows it.

name: Crit
means: A lucky hit that deals double (2x). Crit chance starts at 5%; the creature, its Knack, talents and items add points of chance and add to the multiplier (+1x makes a 3x crit), and a boss with a Lucky Strike crits too.

name: Sure Crit
means: A counter on the creature, up to 3, stored from something that happened to it (a dodge, a hit taken for another creature). Its next hit that lands and is not already a crit spends one and is a guaranteed crit, with the extra damage the effect names (a hit that is a crit anyway keeps it).
not: A Store of a Knack, or a lasting buff
